terms.comment: Traupman’s word for any computer program, and so for an app, which is a program on a phone; where it must be said, tēlephōnī programma. Traupman and Morgan–Owens have no separate word for an app.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 261.
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
